paragraphs: He is mentioned in halakhic discussions in Bava Kamma 109b and Menachot 74b: Ravina asked a question, and Rav Aharon said to Ravina, “Come and hear.”[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Bava Kamma 109b and Menachot 74b paragraphs both have Rav Aharon telling Ravina, Come and hear. That reporting direction and the source’s full Rav title are supported without importing the legal discussions or additional named figures.
